scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Hello {0}, do
you want to buy some items?
You'll have to give me Love
Flowers for them, of course!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
你好，{0}！想買點東西嗎？
當然，要用愛心花來交換！

scripts.text: Yes, sure!
scripts.translation: 當然要

scripts.text: No, never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Select an item.
The amount of Love Flowers you'll need is in brackets.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
請選擇物品。
括號內的數字是所需的愛心花數量。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Are you sure you want to trade ^00aa00{0}x Love Flower ^000000 for ^0055FF{1}^000000?

^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
You'll need more Love Flowers if you want that!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
想要那個的話，你需要更多愛心花！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Are you sure you want to trade ^00aa00{0}x Love Flower ^000000 for ^0055FF{1}^000000?
Have fun with your item!
No, I've changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 改變主意了

scripts.text: Yes, trade!
scripts.translation: 確認交換

scripts.text: Have fun with your item!
scripts.translation: 祝你用得開心！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Thank you so much for
getting our Flowers back!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
非常感謝你把我們的花帶回來！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
You have to bring me 15 Love Flowers!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
你得給我15朵愛心花！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Take this as a little
'thank you'.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
拿這個當作一點謝禮吧。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
If you get more Love
Flowers, you can exchange
them for some sweets here.
See you soon!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
如果你收集到更多愛心花，可以來這裡交換甜點。
下次見！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Please bring a +8 Cake Hat
to the Baker Extraordinaire
standing next to me!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
請把一頂+8蛋糕帽交給我旁邊的非凡麵包師！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Hello {0}, it's
Valentine's Day and we
love to deliver sweet
chocolates.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
你好，{0}！今天是情人節，我們想為大家送上甜甜的巧克力。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Our problem is that we
need a strong person
like you who could help
us, but first you'll have
to bring a +8 Cake Hat
to the Baker Extraordinaire, who
is standing right next to me!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[平卡梅妮婭]^000000
我們需要像你這樣強大的人來幫忙。不過，首先請把一頂+8蛋糕帽交給我旁邊的非凡麵包師！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Pinkamenia]^000000
Hello {0}!

^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Exchange your Love Flowers with Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡麵包師]^000000
拿愛心花去找平卡梅妮婭兌換吧！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Bring 15 Love Flowers to Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡麵包師]^000000
帶15朵愛心花給平卡梅妮婭！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Ah, so Pinkamenia told you
to bring me the +8 Cake
Hat. Now I'm going
to exchange your +8 Cake
Hat for another Cake Hat.
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡麵包師]^000000
啊，平卡梅妮婭讓你把+8蛋糕帽帶來。現在我會用另一頂蛋糕帽換下你的+8蛋糕帽。

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Sorry, but where is your
+8 Cake Hat? Bring
it to me, and remember
to have it equipped!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡麵包師]^000000
不好意思，你的+8蛋糕帽呢？把它帶來，記得先裝備上！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Now, if you wear the
new Cake Hat, there
is a chance that
Demi-Human Monsters will
drop a Love Flower!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡麵包師]^000000
戴上新的蛋糕帽後，擊敗人形魔物時有機會獲得愛心花！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
The mobs stole our Flowers,
which we need to create 
our chocolates. Now get
15 Love Flowers and bring
them to Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
^0000FF[非凡麵包師]^000000
魔物偷走了製作巧克力所需的花。收集15朵愛心花，交給平卡梅妮婭吧！

scripts.text:
^0000FF[Baker Extraordinaire]^000000
Hello, {0}!
